Probably. 🎞 This Week’s Episode We’re cracking open the Patreon vault and bringing you the very best bits from Michael Owen’s Movie Club – our long-running, occasionally sports-adjacent, always entertaining spin-off series. For 58 glorious episodes (and counting), Mike, Elis and Steff have watched and dissected everything from underdog sports dramas to baffling action blockbusters — all launched from Michael Owen’s now-legendary claim that he’s only ever seen 8 films and didn’t like them… because they weren’t real. “It’s supposed to be a sports film podcast… but really, it’s just three blokes with questionable taste in movies.” From Cool Runnings to JFK , The Karate Kid to Field of Dreams , this is your guided tour through the madness, genius, and deep cinematic trauma that is Michael Owen’s Movie Club. 🎧 Want More? This full series is usually only available to our Patreon subscribers. Probably. 🎞 This Week’s Episode We’re cracking open the Patreon vault and bringing you the very best bits from Michael Owen’s Movie Club – our long-running, occasionally sports-adjacent, always entertaining spin-off series. For 58 glorious episodes (and counting), Mike, Elis and Steff have watched and dissected everything from underdog sports dramas to baffling action blockbusters — all launched from Michael Owen’s now-legendary claim that he’s only ever seen 8 films and didn’t like them… because they weren’t real. “It’s supposed to be a sports film podcast… but really, it’s just three blokes with questionable taste in movies.” From Cool Runnings to JFK , The Karate Kid to Field of Dreams , this is your guided tour through the madness, genius, and deep cinematic trauma that is Michael Owen’s Movie Club. 🎧 Want More?       "key": "be8a49a982528dd762b8f8cbb06f77516da1defd",
      "title": "264: Max Rushden (Pt 2)",
      "published_at": "2025-05-16T01:00:00+00:00",
      "link": "https://shows.acast.com/the-socially-distant-sports-bar/episodes/68e8194c658c65a3e98fe4f9",
      "description": "Elis James ( Elis & John , Oh What A Time ), Mike Bubbins ( Mammoth ), and Steff Garrero return with another round of top-tier sporting nonsense, barely researched takes, and an absolutely brilliant special guest. “Like a sports podcast, if the sport was optional.” ✨ This Week’s Special Guest – Max Rushden! If you’ve enjoyed our guest episodes with Chesney Hawkes, Josh Widdicombe, or Sam Warburton, you’re in for a treat. This week we welcome Max Rushden — broadcaster, podcaster, football obsessive, and all-round good guy. Max is the long-running host of Guardian Football Weekly, where he teams up with our friend Barry Glendenning for football chat, laughs, and chaos. He’s also recently launched a new podcast with comedian David O’Doherty called What Did You Do Yesterday?, where they interview fascinating guests about a completely ordinary day. 🎧 Guardian Football Weekly 🎧 What Did You Do Yesterday? Max’s broadcasting career has spanned BBC Radio 5 Live, talkSPORT, Channel 4’s Jump Off , and iconic years hosting Sky’s Soccer AM . Known for his wit, love of the underdog, and eye for the ridiculous, Max fits right in at the Distant Pod. 🎟️ We’re Going on Tour in 2026! We’re hitting the road with a brand-new live show in 2026!       "description": "Elis James ( Elis & John , Oh What A Time ), Mike Bubbins ( Mammoth ), and Steff Garrero return with another round of top-tier sporting nonsense, barely researched takes, and an absolutely brilliant special guest. “Like a sports podcast, if the sport was optional.” ✨ This Week’s Special Guest – Max Rushden! If you’ve enjoyed our guest episodes with Chesney Hawkes, Josh Widdicombe, or Sam Warburton, you’re in for a treat. This week we welcome Max Rushden — broadcaster, podcaster, football obsessive, and all-round good guy. Max is the long-running host of Guardian Football Weekly, where he teams up with our friend Barry Glendenning for football chat, laughs, and chaos. He’s also recently launched a new podcast with comedian David O’Doherty called What Did You Do Yesterday?, where they interview fascinating guests about a completely ordinary day. 🎧 Guardian Football Weekly 🎧 What Did You Do Yesterday? Max’s broadcasting career has spanned BBC Radio 5 Live, talkSPORT, Channel 4’s Jump Off , and iconic years hosting Sky’s Soccer AM . Known for his wit, love of the underdog, and eye for the ridiculous, Max fits right in at the Distant Pod. 🎟️ We’re Going on Tour in 2026! We’re hitting the road with a brand-new live show in 2026!       "description": "This is a trailer for Elis’ new podcast!Take a journey through history with \"Oh What A Time…\" a comedy history podcast featuring (alongside Wales’ best dressed man) renowned comedian Tom Craine along with award winning podcaster (and host of Quickly Kevin) Chris Scull. Tackling a brand new subject each week, (from ‘childhood’ to ‘a life at sea’, ‘marriage’ to ‘holidays’) your hosts will dive into the very weirdest and worst that history has to offer, in an effort to answer the question… \"Was the past as awful as it sounds?\" You can get in touch with the show by emailing: hello@ohwhatatime.comAnd if you like what you hear, feel free to chuck us a subscribe!
